draft.subject: Your Slack integration ticket + a quick next step
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for flagging that the Slack integration page just spins — your ticket is still open and with us, and I'll follow up here as soon as I have something concrete, including on your status page question.

In the meantime, I don't want that to hold up the rest of your setup. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. I also see one invite has gone out from your side.

Want me to walk you through your first project on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
